name: Command<S>

test_list.description: Command<Unverified>::verify(witness) yields Command<Verified> that carries the witness; there is no other public path to Command<Verified>.
Command<Unverified> survives JSON serialize/deserialize with id, frame, token and body intact.
Debug of TokenBytes and of a Command never contains the token bytes.
compile_fail doctest: a function taking Command<Verified> rejects Command<Unverified>.
compile_fail doctest: Command<Verified> does not implement Deserialize (only unverified commands come off the wire).

inputs.name: cmd
inputs.description: Command as submitted by a UI or agent frame.

inputs.name: witness
inputs.description: Evidence that the verifier approved the command.

output_description: A command the kernel handlers may execute.
